headline: Chile Seeks Critical Minerals Cooperation With Japan for Lithium and Copper
summary: Chile is moving to deepen bilateral cooperation with Japan in critical minerals, highlighting its position as the world's leading copper producer and second-largest lithium supplier for EV batteries.
why: Chile controls the world's largest lithium reserves, and securing Asian partnerships is central to global EV supply-chain resilience.

impacts.name: Lithium
impacts.why: Bilateral development agreements with Japanese industrial partners provide long-term procurement demand.
